mono_labels.classes: font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-500

visual_enhancers.background_texture: Implement a pure CSS Blueprint Grid on #050505 background. Use `background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 24px 24px;`
visual_enhancers.borders_and_surfaces: Zero drop shadows. Use 1px inner borders (`border border-white/10`) to separate surfaces. Add `shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]` for elevated buttons or cards.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For Sticky Headers & Floating Navs: `bg-[#050505]/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10`. Do not use muddy grey transparency.
visual_enhancers.hover_interactions: Micro-interactions. Buttons should subtly light up (`hover:bg-white/10`) and lift (`-translate-y-[1px]`). Navigation links should change from `text-zinc-400` to `text-white` with a 0.2s ease transition.

layout_strategy.general_spacing: Generous Spacing. Use `py-24 md:py-32` for main landing sections. Inside cards, strictly use `p-6 md:p-8`.
layout_strategy.grids: Use 'Bento Grid' (Mode A) for the 6 Modules Showcase on the Landing Page (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12` with wide `gap-8`). Use 'Control Room Grid' (Mode B) for the Dashboard/Analyzer pages (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3` with tight `gap-4`).
layout_strategy.alignment: Prioritize left-alignment for dense content and cards. Hero section can be left-aligned or center-aligned but must use high-contrast and tension.

components_styling.buttons: Primary: Flat, sharp edges or max `rounded-md`, `bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200`. Secondary: `bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/5`.
components_styling.inputs_forms: Shadcn Form elements. Strip default styling. Apply: `bg-[#0A0A0A] border-white/10 text-white placeholder:text-zinc-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white focus:border-white`.
components_styling.cards: Minimalist boxes. `bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden`. Add subtle radial gradient on hover for top-tier pricing card.

hero_visuals.description: Do NOT use an image for the hero background. Rely entirely on the deep #050505 color, the CSS Blueprint Grid, and a subtle CSS radial glow (`bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-zinc-800/20 via-[#050505] to-[#050505]`).

logos.description: Use as a partner logo. MUST apply CSS filters: `grayscale contrast-200 opacity-40 hover:opacity-100 mix-blend-screen`.
Use as an abstract branding partner logo. Apply identical CSS filters: `grayscale contrast-200 opacity-40 hover:opacity-100 mix-blend-screen`.

landing_page.instructions: Full marketing site. Hero section MUST include a Gujarati + English headline (e.g., 'TaxSathi AI: તમારો સ્માર્ટ GST સાથી | The Premium GST & Business Engine'). Problem section using stark typography. 6 Modules Showcase using an asymmetrical Bento Grid. Pricing section (Starter ₹2,999, Growth ₹7,999, Enterprise ₹19,999). Include an email Waitlist form and a fixed/floating WhatsApp CTA button (+91-9999999999).

demo_page.instructions: AI GST demo chat. Terminal/Retro-Futurism vibe. Pure black UI with a chat window featuring `border-white/10`. Simulated Gemini 2.5 Flash responses. User input box fixed at the bottom of the container.

module_analyzer.instructions: AI-powered analysis tool. Dense 'Control Room' grid layout. Sidebar for inputs (Idea, Market), main area for AI output (Fit, Pricing Tier, Revenue Impact). Use progress bars or stat cards with monospaced labels.

progress_tracker.instructions: Visual completion dashboard. Display 6 modules with their status. Use a high-contrast glowing border (`border-white` or `border-green-500/50`) for completed modules, and muted `border-white/5 opacity-50` for pending ones. Show a large % completion metric.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST read and implement the colors and fonts exactly as defined. Do NOT use default Tailwind blue/gray.
Install `@phosphor-icons/react` for high-end, duotone, or thin-line technical icons.
Implement `Cabinet Grotesk` and `Manrope` via next/font or standard CSS imports.

For the Landing page WhatsApp CTA, make it a floating high-contrast button (e.g., pure white background with black text/icon) at the bottom right. Avoid standard WhatsApp green as it breaks the Vercel/Linear dark theme.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, chat submit).
If you use Shadcn, you MUST customize its default theme variables to match the `#050505` base and `#0A0A0A` surface colors. Strip away Vercel's default light border styles.
Mock the Gemini 2.5 Flash interactions on the Demo and Analyzer pages with `setTimeout` or static responses.
